root_cause.text: The return value of sg_nents_for_len(), which can be a negative error code, was directly assigned to an unsigned long variable (rctx->in_sg_len) without error checking, causing negative error codes to be implicitly converted to large positive integers that could lead to buffer overflows.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a signed int `sg_len` to capture the return value of sg_nents_for_len(), adds a check `if (sg_len < 0) return sg_len;`, and only then assigns it to the unsigned `rctx->in_sg_len`. The CVE description explicitly states: "The return value of sg_nents_for_len was assigned to an unsigned long in starfive_hash_digest, causing negative error codes to be converted to large positive integers."
